market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI trading near $106 May 1 with today's range 103.38-110.90 — already nearly touched $110. Strait of Hormuz closure causing 9.1mbpd shut-ins; Goldman sees $100+ risk and EIA forecasts Q2 peak near $115. Touch-of-$110 over the entire month of May is highly likely given current geopolitical setup.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden Hormuz reopening or ceasefire could cap upside
